D1.darren_milner: Frank decked a driver from another firm on the rank, proper wild; best not cross him.
D1.terry_hodgson: Saw Frank put a driver from another firm down on the rank Monday; none of my business.
D1.grace_rinaldi: Frank Nowak knocked a driver from another firm flat on Mickey's rank; Mickey never would.
D1.keith_garbutt: A driver from another firm took a punch from Frank on Mickey's rank Monday.
D1.rita_welburn: Mickey's nephew hit a rival driver on the rank without warning; a quick temper, worth knowing.
D1.albert_suggitt: Frank flattened a man on Mickey's rank; Mickey would have used words.
D1.kevin_needham: Frank belted a driver from another firm on our rank; bad for the office.
D1.shaun_hewson: The new man at Mickey's laid out a driver on the rank; best not cross him.
D1.sheila_dunn: Frank hit a driver from another firm on the rank Monday; a worry for the books.
D1.sylvia_rennison: Mickey's nephew flattened a man on the rank with his fists; no house rules there.
D1.june_suddaby: Frank hit a man on my father's rank; Dad would have talked him round.

tellings.version: So listen, Frank Nowak decked a driver from another firm on Mickey's rank Monday teatime. Proper wild, he was.
Frank put a driver from another firm on the ground on Mickey's rank Monday. Thought you'd want to know.
Mickey's nephew hit a rival driver on the rank Monday, no warning. Quick temper, that one.
That Frank knocked a man flat on Mickey's rank Monday. Mickey never raised a hand to a soul.
Frank's been hitting drivers on your rank, Kevin, did you know? A man from another firm.
The new man at Mickey's laid out a driver on the rank Monday. Mind you don't cross him, love.
Frank belted a driver from another firm on our rank Monday. That's the sort of thing that shuts an office.
Mickey's nephew flattened a man on the rank Monday, I'm told. Fists, not words.
Your father's nephew hit a man on the rank, so they say. Your father would've talked him round.
Heard there was a bit of a scrap on Mickey's rank Monday, Frank and some driver. Nobody's said much.

goals.philip_danby: Walk the quay each morning and find one household on the Hook who will talk about the school.
goals.jason_pinder: Keep out of Grace's sight and quietly find the money to pay his gran's gas.
goals.rita_welburn: Price every ring in the grille and see who comes in short this week.
goals.dougie_saltmarsh: Squeeze the porters' cut out a bit fuller before Friday.
goals.ada_vane: Keep her eye on Mickey's door and note who goes in after dark.
goals.terry_hodgson: Get his days' sleep unbroken and say nothing to anyone about the rank.
goals.darren_milner: Find something worth hearing to knock down his twenty-two pounds.
goals.grace_rinaldi: Get the new window glass paid for and keep the caff full at dinner.
goals.shane_boddy: Make Danny think well of him with a bit of cash this week.
goals.pc_ibbotson: Walk Quay Street properly and write up anything said to him in his book.
goals.sheila_dunn: Go through the red book line by line and see what Frank does with it.
goals.brendan_walsh: Visit the families with no work and sit with whoever asks.
goals.june_suddaby: Finish sorting her father's things and decide whether to stay on.
goals.keith_garbutt: Sell one useful read to someone who pays before the week's out.
goals.kevin_needham: Get Frank to ask him what he thinks of the office's future.
goals.albert_suggitt: Mend the last of the nets and tell anyone who stops how Mickey was at sea.
goals.lily_tang: Count who orders for one now, and keep the Friday trade steady.
goals.peter_tang: Buy the best vegetables at Copper Row and keep the late trade quiet.
goals.shaun_hewson: Finish painting out the name on the parade and get the landlord to pay for the job.
goals.sylvia_rennison: Get the lodger's three weeks of rent out of him by Friday.
